section_summary: This section continues a SCAP register of Japanese ship radio stations, listing vessels by administrative region and prefecture, with ports of registry, tonnage, operational agencies, call signs, frequencies, power changes, and emission types. It covers the Matsuyama, Kumamoto, Sendai, and beginning of the Sapporo regions, spanning Kōchi through Hokkaidō. Most entries concern fishing vessels, alongside cargo ships, railroad ferries, research or weather vessels, salvage craft, and Maritime Safety Bureau guard boats.

subfiles.title: SCAP register of Japanese ship radio stations by region and prefecture (continuation)
subfiles.about: A continuing register records Japanese vessels and their authorized or revised radio-station particulars across western, northeastern, and northern Japan.
subfiles.summary: The tables identify vessels by SCAP registration number, name, port of registry, tonnage, operational agency, call sign, frequency and power, and emission type. Pages 321-354 finish the Matsuyama listings for Kōchi and cover the Kumamoto region prefectures from Fukuoka through Nagasaki. Pages 355-397 cover the Sendai region from Aomori through Fukushima, while pages 398-399 begin the Sapporo-region register for Hokkaidō. The entries encompass commercial fishing fleets, cargo and salvage ships, prefectural and research vessels, weather craft, Maritime Safety Bureau guard boats, and government railroad ferries.
